learning_path:
**Learning Path for Data Science in 6 Months**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1-2 weeks | EDX140 | The Essentials of Data Literacy Online Course | edx | Foundational knowledge of data literacy, including data analysis, visualization, and communication. |
| 2-4 weeks | EDX3425 | Data Science with Python | edx | Develops skills in data science and analysis techniques, including machine learning and statistical learning theory. |
| 4-6 weeks | EDX657 | Data Analytics Basics for Everyone | edx | Introduces data structures, file formats, and data sources, as well as data warehousing and ETL processes. |
| 6 weeks | EDX267 | Programming for Data Science | edx | Focuses on programming concepts, data analysis, and computational thinking. |
| 8-10 weeks | EDX2052 | Introduction to Data Science with Python | edx | Develops hands-on experience with Python programming and coding for modeling, statistics, and storytelling. |
| 10-12 weeks | EDX3032 | R Programming Basics for Data Science | edx | Introduces R programming language and data structures, including vectors, factors, lists, and data frames. |
| 12-14 weeks | EDX2310 | Python Basics for Data Science | edx | Develops skills in Python programming and data analysis, including data visualization and machine learning. |
| 14-16 weeks | EDX575 | Big Data Technology Capstone Project | edx | Applies knowledge of big data technologies to a real-life scenario, including data warehousing, data lakes, and ETL processes. |
| 16 weeks | EDX873 | Analyzing Data with Python | edx | Focuses on data analysis and visualization using Python, including Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy libraries. |

The learning path starts with foundational knowledge of data literacy, followed by development of skills in data science and analysis techniques. The path then introduces data structures, file formats, and data sources, as well as data warehousing and ETL processes. The learner will also develop skills in programming concepts, data analysis, and computational thinking. Finally, the path focuses on hands-on experience with Python programming and coding for modeling, statistics, and storytelling, as well as data visualization and machine learning.
expanded_query: I want to learn data science in 6 months, with a prerequisite level of beginner and a duration of 6 months.

**Learning Path Recommendation**
=====================================

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU4667 | Introduction to Cybersecurity Foundations | Coursera | Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, networking, and cloud computing. |
| 2 | COU2156 | IT Fundamentals for Cybersecurity Specialization | Coursera | Builds on foundational knowledge, covering networking basics, cybersecurity, and database vulnerabilities. |
| 3 | COU5344 | Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Develops foundational knowledge into a comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity, including computer security incident management and security domains. |
| 4 | COU6211 | Cybersecurity and Its Ten Domains | Coursera | Expands knowledge to cover the ten domains of cybersecurity, including cryptography and information security. |
| 5 | COU3464 | Offensive Hacking Unfolded - Become a Pro Pentester | Coursera | Introduces penetration testing and ethical hacking concepts, building on foundational knowledge. |
| 6 | COU1681 | Cybersecurity Operations Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Develops skills in cybersecurity operations, including network security and information security. |
| 7 | COU1293 | Certified Ethical Hacking (v12) Specialization | Coursera | Advances to intermediate-level ethical hacking, covering cryptography, network security, and penetration testing. |
| 8 | COU3642 | The Complete Pentesting and Privilege Escalation Course | Coursera | Focuses on advanced pentesting and privilege escalation techniques, building on intermediate-level knowledge. |
| 9 | COU5900 | Introduction to Network Security | Coursera | Introduces network security concepts, including network architecture and cybersecurity. |
| 10 | COU1476 | Preparing for Your Professional Cloud Network Engineer Journey | Coursera | Develops advanced skills in cloud network engineering, including load balancing and network security. |

**Path Explanation**
-------------------

This learning path is designed to progress from foundational knowledge of cybersecurity concepts to advanced skills in penetration testing and cloud network engineering. The path starts with an introduction to cybersecurity foundations, followed by a specialization in IT fundamentals, which covers networking basics and cybersecurity. The next step is a comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity, including computer security incident management and security domains. The path then expands to cover the ten domains of cybersecurity, including cryptography and information security. The learner is then introduced to penetration testing and ethical hacking concepts, followed by a specialization in cybersecurity operations. The path advances to intermediate-level ethical hacking, covering cryptography, network security, and penetration testing. The learner is then focused on advanced pentesting and privilege escalation techniques. Finally, the path concludes with an introduction to network security concepts and advanced skills in cloud network engineering.

This path covers the full duration of the learner's request, with at least one course per period. The courses are chosen to build on each other, progressing from foundational to advanced knowledge. The path prioritizes hands-on exercises, simulations, and real-world projects to help the learner apply theoretical concepts to real-world scenarios.

2        | COU1870   | Cloud Computing Primer: Platform as a Service (PaaS) | Coursera | In-depth knowledge of cloud platforms and PaaS

4        | COU2175   | Cloud Fundamentals | Coursera | Foundational knowledge of cloud computing deployment models and service providers
5        | COU4841   | Palo Alto Networks Cloud Security Fundamentals | Coursera | Advanced knowledge of cloud security, including malware and denial-of-service attack (DoS) prevention
5        | COU4922   | Intro to Managing Resources Using Infrastructure-as-Code | Coursera | Practical skills in infrastructure-as-code management

---------------------------

This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of cloud computing infrastructure and DevOps deployment, progressing from foundational to advanced knowledge. The first period covers the basics of cloud computing and DevOps, while the second period delves deeper into cloud platforms and PaaS. The third period focuses on practical skills in DevOps deployment on AWS, including continuous integration and delivery. The fourth period covers advanced knowledge of DevOps on AWS, including continuous integration and delivery, and preparation for Google Cloud certification. The final period emphasizes cloud security and infrastructure-as-code management. Each course builds on the previous one, providing a cohesive and structured learning experience.

learning_path:
**Learning Path for Discrete Mathematics and Logic**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX1479 | How to Code: Simple Data | edx | Introduces the basics of data representation and programming concepts |
| 2 | EDX874 | Computer Vision for Embedded Systems | edx | Builds on the previous course by introducing computer vision concepts |
| 3 | EDX1758 | Graph Algorithms | edx | Explores graph algorithms and their applications in computer science |
| 4 | EDX1482 | Optimization: principles and algorithms - Network and discrete optimization | edx | Covers optimization techniques and their applications in computer science |
| 5 | EDX1629 | C Programming: Advanced Data Types | edx | Focuses on advanced data types and programming concepts in C |
| 6 | EDX2780 | Cyber Security Basics: A Hands-on Approach | edx | Introduces the basics of cyber security and its applications in computer science |
| 7 | EDX1079 | Digital Design | edx | Covers digital design concepts and their applications in computer science |
| 8 | EDX1626 | C Programming: Modular Programming and Memory Management | edx | Explores modular programming and memory management concepts in C |
| 9 | EDX590 | Google AI for Anyone | edx | Introduces machine learning and AI concepts and their applications in computer science |
| 10 | EDX2093 | MATLAB Essentials | edx | Covers the basics of MATLAB programming and its applications in computer science |

This learning path starts with the basics of data representation and programming concepts in "How to Code: Simple Data" (EDX1479). **Learning Path for Photography and Visual Design**
==============================================

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU4519 | Photography Capstone Project | Coursera | This course provides a foundation in photography and visual design, covering the basics of light, composition, and visual elements. |
| 2 | COU3003 | Design Fundamentals | Coursera | Building on the previous course, this one covers the fundamentals of visual design, including typography, color theory, and visual storytelling. |
| 3 | COU4668 | Graphic Design Fundamentals | Coursera | This course introduces the basics of graphic design, including color schemes, visual storytelling, and visual design principles. |
| 4 | COU5436 | Image Editing | Coursera | With a solid foundation in graphic design, this course teaches image editing skills using Adobe Photoshop. |
| 5 | COU4519 | Photography Capstone Project | Coursera | This course provides an opportunity to apply the skills learned in the previous courses to a real-world project, with feedback and guidance. |

**How the path fits together**

This learning path is designed to take a complete beginner in photography and visual design from the basics to a more advanced level. The first course, Photography Capstone Project, provides a foundation in photography and visual design, covering the basics of light, composition, and visual elements. The second course, Design Fundamentals, builds on this foundation, covering the fundamentals of visual design, including typography, color theory, and visual storytelling. The third course, Graphic Design Fundamentals, introduces the basics of graphic design, including color schemes, visual storytelling, and visual design principles. The fourth course, Image Editing, teaches image editing skills using Adobe Photoshop. Finally, the fifth course, Photography Capstone Project, provides an opportunity to apply the skills learned in the previous courses to a real-world project, with feedback and guidance. This path is designed to be progressive, with each course building on the previous one, and to provide a solid foundation in photography and visual design.
